11.reader_note: This gap is a claim that a study has NOT been done. Searches of PubMed and of the registry's own 2025 report and publication list found no analysis of race, ethnicity, income or access among islet transplant recipients. The reason to ask: of recipients whose race was recorded, 98% were White, while national survey data show type 1 diabetes in Black and Hispanic US adults at rates close to White adults. The papers listed here are context on the registry and on transplant outcomes; none is about equity.
